name: Shihlin Electric & Engineering Corp.
summary: Shihlin Electric & Engineering Corp. manufactures and sells heavy electrical equipment and machinery and automotive electrical equipment, devices, and related parts in Taiwan, Mainland China, Vietnam, and internationally. The company offers automobile parts, such as alternators, starters, wiper systems, and fan motors; traction motor and motor controller EV powertrains; EV chargers; motorcycle parts, including ISG, AC generator, fuel pumps, and ignition coils; and DC, gear, transaxle motor.
